label: J189 IP phone
description: Avaya J189 SIP desk phone with two colour displays, 16 feature keys and up to two J100 expansion modules, on dual 10/100/1000 Ethernet ports (network plus PC passthrough). PoE class is set by a hardware slideswitch: class 2 in the L position, class 3 in H.
notes: Avaya specs: 'Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps) line interface', 'Secondary Gigabit Ethernet (10/100/1000 Mbps) interface ... for a PC', 'PoE Class 2 IEEE 802.3af when PoE Slideswitch is in L position, and PoE Class 3 IEEE 802.3af when ... in H position'. Modelled at class 2 (6.49 W); flip the slideswitch to H and the switch has to find 12.95 W, which is a nice mis-configuration scenario. Some Avaya marketing sheets call the J189 a 'PoE Class 1 design' - the documentation's class 2/3 statement is used here. Optional Wi-Fi/Bluetooth via USB dongles, so no built-in wireless; USB-A/USB-C and headset ports not modelled.
